description: This file defines base classes and data structures for observing and monitoring frame flow within the Pipecat pipeline, including event data classes and an abstract base observer class.

classes.name: FrameProcessed
classes.description: Event data for a frame being processed by a processor, including processor, frame, direction, and timestamp.

classes.name: FramePushed
classes.description: Event data for a frame transfer between processors, including source, destination, frame, direction, and timestamp.

classes.name: BaseObserver
classes.description: Abstract base class for pipeline frame observers, providing async methods for handling frame processing and transfer events.

methods.name: on_process_frame
methods.description: Async method to handle frame processing events; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Async method to handle frame transfer events; to be implemented by subclasses.
